text:
Maya: Quick question 447 procurement is evaluating AuditTrail for invoice ingest/reconciliation. Need CSV schema (nested lines?), dedupe behavior, and pricing (per-invoice vs flat). Any gotchas?

Jordan: I saw their demo last week. They accept a line_items_json column for nested items. UI backfill only 60 days; they have a bulk API for older history. Dedupe by (source, external_id) if provided.

Priya: Also ask about rate limits for bulk backfills — our close window can spike a lot.

procurement: @vendor-ops can you confirm schema + sample curl? Also whether gzipped CSV is supported.

vendor-ops: Hi all 44b We accept gzipped CSV/NDJSON. Canonical fields: external_id, account_id, invoice_date, due_date, currency, total_amount, tax_amount, line_items_json. Sample curl:

curl -X POST https://api.audittrail.example/v1/imports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "file=@invoices.csv.gz" \
  -F "mapping=external_id,account_id,invoice_date,total_amount"

vendor-ops: For dedupe we use (source_system, external_id); if absent we fallback to amount+date heuristics. Bulk rate limits: 2 concurrent uploads, recommend batch sizes <= 50k rows.

Maya: Good. Pricing? We need napkin TCO for ~300k invoices/yr.

vendor-ops: Pricing: $0.03/invoice + $250/mo platform fee. One-time onboarding $1,000. Volume discounts kick in >1M/yr. Example 300k => 300k*0.03 + 250*12 = $9,000 + $3,000 = $12,000/yr (plus onboarding).

Finance-bot: Reminder: pilots under $2k can be manager-approved. Anything >$10k/yr needs director approval.

Legal: We'll need a DPA, 30-day data return or deletion clause, and BYOK option for EU residency. Confirm encryption at rest.

Maya: Proposed 7-day pilot. Maya -> AuditTrail POC owner, Jordan -> perf tests. Procurement, please get sandbox creds and a sample nested-lines CSV.

procurement: @vendor-ops please DM sandbox token and sample.

vendor-ops: Will DM credentials and sample CSV now. Happy to extend pilot rate limits for testing.

Maya: Thanks 44d will post results next week.
